plain: A line, measured in how much computing was used to train a model, above which extra rules apply.
eli5: Small cakes need no inspection. Once a cake needed a whole truck of flour, the inspector comes.
technical: A regulatory trigger defined by training compute, usually in floating-point operations: for example the EU AI Act presumes systemic risk above 10<sup>25</sup> FLOP. It is a proxy for capability, used as a first filter for which models get scrutiny.
